candidate_payload.research_markdown:
# Prevention-system completion research

## Current state
The complete property does not hold system-wide. The registry still separates classification, selection, activation, run start, guarding, verification, and close; the research runner is one representative complete owner rather than a generic prevention-system owner. Typed exact schemas exist in selected controllers, but checked execution still accepts arbitrary argv, the guard compares shell strings, and work-memory accepts JSON-file and argv-JSON inputs. Pre-action enforcement is opt-in through skill compliance: direct shell, edit, MCP/tool, browser, subagent, and remote-workflow action boundaries can bypass applicability selection. Corrections are strongly evidence-bound but only become selectable when callers supply fingerprint context; they are not universally mandatory. Observer-to-discovery evidence and promotion controllers exist, but promotion is explicitly invoked and a later link does not dispatch the implementation. Research admission reserves core, one concurrent lens window, and adjudicator time, omitting retries, materialization, package verification, terminal emission, and controller overhead. Durable resume exists in selected slices but not through one common journal across every sequence. Current metrics omit the system-wide registered-use denominator, raw rate, prevented failures, mechanical-failure time, promoted reuse, and real-run overhead proof.

## Complete future system
Every registered operational sequence needs one deterministic typed invocation backed by a closed operation registry. An unavoidable dispatcher interceptor must derive the intended typed operation, select one compatible registered implementation or fail closed, and cover every action class. Same-path-verified correction evidence must prohibit the predecessor and make the active successor mandatory. One causal lineage must join intent through registered verification and reuse while preserving qualification and promotion authorities. Admission must reserve core, three gates, adjudication, retries, materialization, verification, terminal emission, and overhead before launch. A shared transition/effect journal must give every sequence exact-once recovery, multi-run preservation, and branch-safe ownership. Canonical events and denominators must measure registered use, raw dispatch, mechanical failures, recurrence, promoted reuse, prevention, and total overhead.

## Acceptance
The final implementation must prove zero raw governed dispatch, zero execution of a prohibited repeated fingerprint, zero long-stage launch below full-unit budget, mandatory corrected-path selection on a fresh compatible task, at least 95 percent registered use over an explicit recurring-action denominator, and at most 10 percent mechanical overhead over representative real governed runs. Synthetic timing tests are not sufficient for the last condition.

exclusions: implementation planning or code changes during research
commit, push, deployment, secret access, external messaging, or phase-ledger contract changes
conversation transcripts, hidden reasoning, personal data, credentials, or raw terminal output as durable learning evidence
dashboard or user-interface design beyond the metric contracts required for acceptance
sequence catalog cleanup unrelated to the prevention-system acceptance requirements
in_scope: memory-knowledge operational sequence registry, selector, guard, checked execution, observer, blocker/correction ledger, discovery, promotion, registered verification, budget, resume, and metrics contracts
research-playbook execution only as one representative sequence and integration surface, not as the whole system
mcp-agents-workflow and Codex action boundaries only where required to ground automatic pre-action interception
all eight user-provided enforcement properties and all six user-provided measurable completion conditions
charter.objective: Assess the real current implementation against the complete mechanical-error prevention system and produce a planner-ready package that grounds every missing mechanism and end-to-end acceptance boundary without narrowing the goal.
research_questions: Does every operational sequence have one executable owner for initialization through terminal emission?
Are mechanical operations typed and schema-validated rather than reconstructed through shell, JSON, or text manipulation?
Is sequence applicability intercepted and enforced before every mechanical action rather than depending on voluntary registry consultation?
Does a same-path-verified correction prohibit the failed fingerprint and become the mandatory successor?
Is intent through promoted registered reuse one automatically joined causal learning lifecycle?
Does admission reserve the entire atomic unit before long work begins?
Can every completed transition resume idempotently from durable state?
Do system-wide metrics prove registered reuse, prevented failures, recurrence reduction, and mechanical-overhead targets?
charter.supplied_input: The complete prevention system has one executable sequence owner, typed operations, automatic pre-action interception, mandatory verified correction replacement, automatic causal discovery-to-promotion learning, full-unit budget admission, durable idempotent resume, and system-wide enforcement metrics. Completion requires zero raw JSON/text patching in governed runs, zero repeated mechanical fingerprints, no under-budget long-stage start, mandatory reuse of verified corrections, at least 95 percent registered use for recurring actions, and mechanical overhead below 5 to 10 percent.

BLOCKED means required accessible evidence or a named approval route is unavailable.
CAP_REACHED means the shared time, round, attempt, retry, or repeated-fingerprint cap fired.
